description:
Why it barely stabilized, measured on the owner's 25 gyro logs and 4
pulled handheld clips (core/tests/stab_measure, sync_measure):

- Sync: the anchored offset (frame-0 RECEIVE wall time vs the gcsv
  header) was 83-135 ms late on every clip per the optical sync, which
  was off by default. At that error the warp amplified shake: median
  residual 1.40x raw. Now: a measured 110 ms receive-lag prior on the
  anchor (bound 50 ms), optical refine ON by default with a +-300 ms
  search, frames timed at capture + 0.5*exposure (the frame JSON has
  exposureTime, FrameInfo::exposureNs).
- Orientation: VQF's accel tilt corrections (5-23 deg start-up swing,
  walking wobble) were treated as camera motion (required crop up to
  128x). Smooth/LockFirstFrame and the optical refine now use the
  bias-corrected gyro-only integration; HorizonLock keeps VQF.
